description:
Log in to the OpenMRS Administration interface (https://localhost/openmrs/admin) using credentials username: 'superman' and password: 'Admin123'.

Navigate to 'Manage Relationship Types' and create a new relationship type with the following details:
- A is to B Name: 'Community Health Worker'
- B is to A Name: 'Client'
- Description: 'Links a community health worker to their assigned client for ongoing care coordination and follow-up'

Save the new relationship type.

metadata.expected_description: Links a community health worker to their assigned client for ongoing care coordination and follow-up
